item.title: Young, Old Dems Kick Off 2026 - New Haven Independent
item.description: Standing in a Crown Street bar packed with young Democratic politicos from across Connecticut, 72-year-old Gov. Ned Lamont pointed to 33-year-old East Rock/Fair Haven Alder Caroline Tanbee Smith and said, "You're happening!" While not necessarily a passing of the torch, it was recognition by the party's older generation of its burgeoning young talent.
